nu_zero_control.reason: Plane-strain/plane-stress coincide at nu=0; not a concrete property proposal

boundary: Uy=0 everywhere; Uz=0 on theta=0 face; one Ux datum at theta=0,r=Rm,Y=b/2. Radial faces free. End theta=90 has exact Airy sigma_tt traction integrated consistently. No gravity, rigid clamp, connectors, prestress or steel.
geometry_comparison: H20-CHORD midside nodes are Cartesian edge averages of the same 8 corners, yielding the same faceted geometry as H8. H20-CURVED arc-edge midside nodes lie on the circle, yielding a quadratic approximation, NOT exact circular geometry. Same partitions do not mean same DOF/cost.
stress_axes: er radial out, et increasing theta in XZ plane, ey global+Y. Components are explicit tensor projections; tension positive; kPa.

qa_declared_before_solving.scope: Diagnostic coupon checks only. All six stress components and all listed accuracy targets; no production approval and no relaxation of earlier Step2 criteria.
